short: 3D DenseNet regressor (M06) and LJ-Speech WaveNet (M08) are standard: no in-paper baseline, mixed later head-to-heads, and no listener test behind the quality claims.
position: The paper changes the neural-to-spectrogram regressor (M06), a per-participant 3D DenseNet over the ECoG grid and time, and the waveform generator (M08), a WaveNet trained on the single-speaker LJ-Speech corpus [@angrick2019speech]. Both are standard. The 3D convolution over grid topography anticipated the decoder family that holds the best ECoG correlations today [@chen2024neural], but no simpler regressor is trained on the same folds, and [later] head-to-head tests are mixed: a recurrent encoder-decoder beat it on sEEG [@kohler2022synthesizing], and it was only marginally ahead of a sequence model on HD ECoG [@berezutskaya2023direct]. The evaluation (M12) has a strong retrained shuffle null but no listener or identification test, so the quality and naturalness claims are assertions; the [concurrent] sentence-level system [@anumanchipalli2019speech] backed its claim with listener transcription.
